"""Ranking demo for the Universal Search Engine record 24: The Universal Search Engine Field Guide Index.
A small working ranker: scores the 24 record titles of this database
against a query built from this record's own title words."""
import hashlib
TITLES = ['What a Search Engine Is', 'Crawling: Finding Pages', 'Indexing: The Inverted Index', 'Ranking: Putting the Best First', 'The Query Box and the Results Page', 'Snippets and Titles', 'Language Detection', 'Safe Search and Spam Filters', 'Semantic Search: Meaning, Not Just Words', 'Query Understanding and Intent', 'Federated Search Across Collections', 'Personal Results Without Personal Data', 'Freshness: New Pages, Fast', 'Multilingual Search', 'Image, Audio and Video Search', 'Search Suggestions and Spelling', 'Ranking at Planetary Scale', 'The Universal Index: One Index for Every Public Record', 'Privacy-Preserving Search Architecture', 'Adversarial Search: Spam, Cloaking and Manipulation', 'Search Quality Measurement', "The Search Engine's Own AI Explainer", 'Open Search Standards and Interoperability', 'The Universal Search Engine Field Guide Index']
QUERY = 'universal search engine field guide index'
def words(s):
    return [w.strip(".,:;()").lower() for w in s.split() if len(w.strip(".,:;()")) > 3]
def score(title):
    qw = set(words(QUERY)); tw = set(words(title))
    return len(qw & tw)
ranked = sorted(((score(t), t) for t in TITLES), key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))
print("Universal Search Engine ranking demo — record 24: The Universal Search Engine Field Guide Index")
print("Query words: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(words(QUERY)))))
for s, t in ranked[:5]:
    print("  score %d — %s" % (s, t))
print("Records scored: %d" % len(ranked))
h = hashlib.sha256(("|".join(t for _, t in ranked)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: top result shares a query word — " + ("pass" if score(ranked[0][1]) > 0 else "fail"))
print("Test: scores are sorted descending — " + ("pass" if [s for s, _ in ranked] == sorted([s for s, _ in ranked], reverse=True) else "fail"))
print("Test: all 24 titles scored — " + ("pass" if len(ranked) == 24 else "fail"))
print("Test: ranking is deterministic — " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(("|".join(t for _, t in ranked)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))
